_comment: Nine EU and UK institutional feeds, all confirmed returning items on 24 Aug 2026. Tier 1 sources get a small scoring bonus over tier 2. Scope is deliberately EU + UK only.

sources.name: EUR-Lex — Official Journal L (adopted acts)
sources.note: The legal texts themselves. More predefined feeds at https://eur-lex.europa.eu/predefined-rss.html

sources.name: Council of the EU — press releases
sources.note: Where sanctions packages are actually adopted. Carries some French-language items; the noise list drops them.

sources.name: European Parliament — press releases
sources.note: Committee stages, votes and trilogue outcomes - the in-progress pipeline.

sources.name: OFSI — financial sanctions (HM Treasury)
sources.note: General licences, designations, enforcement. The single best UK sanctions source.

sources.name: FCDO — sanctions and foreign policy
sources.note: UK designations and the Sanctions List updates.

sources.name: Department for Business and Trade
sources.note: Export controls, trade remedies, and UKCA/CE marking - the divergence beat's UK end.

sources.name: gov.uk — news and communications
sources.note: Broad catch-all across departments. High volume, so the filter does the work.
